title: Google Play & App Store Reviews Scraper
desc: Get app reviews from Google Play and the App Store in one format: stars, text, date, version and developer reply, plus a rating snapshot per app. Rating and date filters, only-new mode for review alerts, full app details and keyword app search for ASO. Pay per review.

title: Shopify Products Scraper: Prices, Variants, Stock & Launches
desc: Scrape every product from any Shopify store or collection: price, compare-at price and discount, stock, variants, sizes and colors, tags, images and launch dates. Plus a free store summary with price range, top product types and what launched in the last 30 days.

title: Google News Scraper & API: Articles and News Alerts
desc: Google News scraper and API for any keyword in 70+ countries and any language: title, publisher, direct article URL, snippet, publish time, thumbnail and Top stories. Past hour to custom dates, newest first, publisher filters and an only-new mode for scheduled news alerts. Pay per article.
